title = 'About this proof'

This standalone page uses the same article renderer without belonging to a collection.

## A shared publishing space

Blogs, notes and documentation have different ways of organizing material. A
standalone page still uses the same site navigation and reading shell.

## Make the shell your own

The optional shell examples select native menus and reorder both regions. This
page has no collection owner: site settings apply unless its own front matter
explicitly replaces them. Compact is a choice, not a special standalone renderer.
